conditions.transport: no real MCP process; deterministic known-tool resolver
conditions.security_oracle: policy decision plus grant lifecycle state

cases.detail: Dynamic MCP default is outbound_ask; no coordinator execution is fail-safe denied by existing e2e tests.
Target identity is resolved from the known tool set, not from nested args.
Enterprise deny is evaluated before grant matching.
The enabled probe is a DENY gate before grant lookup.
Expired grants are not returned by PermissionGrantStore.match.
A grant bound to workspace A does not match workspace B.
Revoke removes the matching grant immediately in the current process.
Current v2 MCP grant fingerprint is tool-identity based and excludes args; this case detects that limitation.
A normal retry intentionally reuses a live saved grant; TTL/revoke are the lifecycle controls. No implicit per-retry re-prompt exists.
